description: Free during beta. Describe a company in plain words (what it sells, where). Returns the open public tenders it could bid on, best match first, each with 'competition' signals from the buyer's past contracts (median bidders, single-bid share, % below estimate).

company_description.description: e.g. 'We install solar panels and EV chargers for municipalities'. English matches tenders in every EU language; adding key terms in the target country's language improves recall.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes where the work is performed, e.g. ["PT","ES"]

name: match_company
